description: This Java class 'DefaultFailureHandler' implements a Vert.x Handler to process failed HTTP routing contexts, setting appropriate HTTP response codes and messages based on the exception type.

classes.name: DefaultFailureHandler
classes.description: A handler for processing failed HTTP routes, setting error responses based on exception types.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the RoutingContext to handle failures, setting appropriate HTTP error responses.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response status code and body with the provided error message.
